suite: RM Co-pilot — Layer 3 agent workflow evaluation
description: The ten realistic RM scenarios from the master prompt (§13 Layer 3). Each case runs a Tier 2 workflow against fixture CRM state and asserts on the structured result using the shared assertion matcher (src/evals/matcher.py). Declarative on purpose so the scenarios stay reviewable by non-engineers.

scenarios.name: New lead with incomplete information
scenarios.rationale: An unqualified inbound enquiry must be qualified, not quoted. The co-pilot must refuse to speculate and must name what is missing.

scenarios.name: Client summary surfaces gaps rather than inventing them
Stalled opportunity is detected and escalated
scenarios.rationale: OPP-1002 has sat 64 days in a 21-day SLA stage.

scenarios.name: Overdue follow-up is prioritised
scenarios.rationale: Overdue commitments to the client outrank routine pipeline work.

scenarios.name: Missing documents are surfaced as open items
scenarios.rationale: CLT-007823 has two MISSING documents on file.

scenarios.name: Cross-sell: active client with known needs
scenarios.rationale: Existing engagements establish what the firm already does for the client, which is the basis for a cross-sell conversation.

scenarios.name: High-value opportunity with weak recent activity
scenarios.rationale: OPP-1002 is USD 95,000 with no contact for 38 days — must not be treated as routine.

scenarios.name: Conflicting CRM information is reconciled, not trusted
scenarios.rationale: OPP-1002 is still open at NEGOTIATION while its expected close date passed 9 days ago. The record contradicts itself; the co-pilot must flag it rather than forecast from it.

scenarios.name: Insufficient information blocks commercial recommendation
scenarios.rationale: An opportunity with no value, service type or close date cannot support a priced proposal.

scenarios.name: Escalation required — open compliance flag blocks progression
scenarios.rationale: CLT-009001 carries an open compliance flag. Policy blocks client-facing progression until cleared; the recommendation must be escalation at CRITICAL priority.

scenarios.name: Draft follow-up is always human-gated and never sent
scenarios.rationale: Governance rows 4/5/7 — the agent drafts, the human reviews and sends.

scenarios.name: Healthy opportunity is not falsely alarmed
scenarios.rationale: Guards against a rules engine that flags everything — a within-SLA opportunity must read LOW.
